hanka_b97: The new rifleman gave his name as Bastian "Owl" Hanka. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Bastian "Owl" Hanka was number 2. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Bastian "Owl" Hanka counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
The relief reached S-F11 without Bastian "Owl" Hanka. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead.
mng.ngaihte: The quartermaster asked Benedikt Ngaihte to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
A clear shot from R-F7. Benedikt Ngaihte grazed Jonas Steini and slid back down below the parapet.
